answer: Tie each identity's grading weight to stake that unlocks only after it survives a full epoch at its reputation nadir: new accounts start with zero weight and must earn it through graded work that peers outside their invite cluster confirm. A sybil operator trying to forge a hundred voters must lock a hundred stakes and wait them all out, so a rising tide of fake accounts arrives weightless and is cheap to ignore, while slashing any cluster caught cross-grading makes coordination expensive.
